BTC.note: Binance hack: an exchange breach, not Bitcoin itself; 95% covered, withdrawals reopening
BTC.detail: Binance (an exchange) lost about US$6.3bn on 29-30 Oct; the FBI says North Korea did it. It was not a flaw in Bitcoin. Binance says about 95% of losses are now replenished from its own funds (BTC fully backed) and began reopening withdrawals in phases on 1 Nov, Bitcoin first, from new wallet addresses; a verifiable reserves proof is expected around 3 Nov. The attacker's 18,270 stolen BTC are still reported unmoved; watch for selling. Separately, Bitcoin Core fixed a medium-severity node memory bug (CVE-2026-117350) on non-Linux nodes; no funds at risk. Quantum: new estimates remain theoretical, hardware expected early 2030s.

TSLA.detail: No confirmed Tesla breach. A Sept 2026 hacking-forum claim is unverified.

MSTR.detail: Strategy itself was not hacked. The Binance hack only moved its share price through Bitcoin.

SEMI.detail: No breaches at SEMI's top holdings. Intel's Israel factory explosion is an operations issue, not a security one.
